1girl, 1boy, seated mage foreground right, standing warrior behind her left shoulder, looking at viewer.

Landscape composition, natural relative scale, layered silhouettes. She sits sideways on a carved chair, both hands on an ancient book in her lap; he holds a tiny coffee cup and saucer. Two floating books, faint golden circle beneath chair.

Dark paneled interior, narrow cold sidelight, half the warrior concealed in black shadow. Pale jade, bone white, ink black, restrained gold and orange accents, intimidating stillness.
